trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State the problem and order ID, expressing urgency.
steps.text: सुनिए, मेरे पास बिल्कुल time नहीं है। मेरा order ORD-40004 का refund नहीं आया है अभी तक।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the issue and prepare to assist.
steps.text: नमस्कार। माफ़ी चाहूंगा कि आपको परेशानी हुई। मैं आपकी सहायता करता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Provide the item details and amount, reiterating urgency.
steps.text: हाँ जल्दी करो। मैंने पिछले हफ्ते chair return की थी, 8999 rupees का amount था।

steps.purpose: Ask for pincode to verify identity.
steps.text: जी, मैं समझ सकता हूँ। Security के लिए, क्या आप अपना registered pincode बता सकते हैं?
Pincode 110001 है। जल्दी check करो।

steps.purpose: Inform failure and ask for another factor.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, pincode match नहीं हुआ। क्या आप registered name बता सकते हैं?
अरे यार, मेरा नाम Rahul है।
धन्यवाद Rahul जी। मैं आपकी details check कर रहा हूँ, इस process में थोड़ा समय लग सकता है क्योंकि हमें...
अरे भाई, मुझे पूरी कहानी मत सुनाओ। सीधा बताओ refund मिलेगा या नहीं?

steps.purpose: Ask for the reason for return.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल। बस एक जानकारी चाहिए, आपने यह chair किस कारण से return की थी?
मैंने अपना mind change कर लिया था, मुझे वो chair नहीं चाहिए थी। जल्दी check करो।

steps.purpose: Confirm eligibility and ask to process refund.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। आपका return eligible है। चूँकि आप chair पहले ही वापस कर चुके हैं, क्या मैं आपका refund process कर दूँ?
हाँ भाई, इसीलिए तो call किया है। जल्दी process करो।

steps.purpose: State intention to refund to original payment.
steps.text: मैं इसे आपके original payment method में process करने की कोशिश करता हूँ। कृपया line पर बने रहें।
ठीक है, जल्दी करो। मेरे पास time नहीं है।

steps.purpose: Attempt to issue refund to original payment.
Explain block and ask for wallet alternative.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिएगा, system ने original payment में refund block कर दिया है। क्या मैं refund आपके wallet में issue कर दूँ?
अरे यार! ठीक है, wallet में ही डाल दो, बस पैसे दे दो।
मैंने आपके wallet में refund issue कर दिया है। Refund ID REF-12345 है और यह 5 दिन के अंदर credit हो जाएगा।
चलो ठीक है। Callback कर लेना अगर कोई issue हो।
ज़रूर, हम आपको update करते रहेंगे। Call करने के लिए धन्यवाद।

ir.terminal_condition: Refund issued and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly waits for the user's confirmation and the successful tool result from 'schedule_pickup' before confirming to the customer that the pickup has been scheduled.
variant_findings.label: General Guardrails > Hallucination Resistance > Action Completion Hallucination

variant_findings.reason: The agent hallucinates that the system shows the pickup as 'pending' in e16, which is not supported by the tool output in e15, directly violating the grounding requirement.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e14, the agent calls `check_return_eligibility` with `reason: 'changed_mind'`, but the user never stated the reason for returning the item.
issues.repair_instruction: From e14, have the agent ask the user for the reason for their return before calling the `check_return_eligibility` tool.

issues.detail: In e16, the agent claims the system shows the pickup is pending, which is not present in the tool output of e15.
issues.repair_instruction: Do not fabricate system statuses. The agent should confirm eligibility based solely on the tool output and then proceed to ask about scheduling the pickup.

issues.detail: In e24, the agent calls `issue_refund` before the pickup has occurred, violating BR_RT_04 which states that the refund follows pickup.
issues.repair_instruction: The agent must not call `issue_refund` before the pickup. Instead, inform the user that the refund can only be processed after the pickup is completed.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates resistance to action completion hallucination and captures the time-pressured persona well. However, it fails on tool output grounding by hallucinating a 'pickup pending' status. Additionally, the agent guesses the return reason without asking the user, and violates business rules by attempting to issue a refund before the pickup has occurred. A suffix repair from e14 is required to fix these issues.

variant_findings.reason: The agent explicitly states they will 'try to process' the refund (e20), waits for the tool result, handles the blocked status (e23, e24), attempts the wallet route (e26), and only confirms the refund is issued after receiving the successful tool result (e27, e28). This perfectly demonstrates avoiding action completion hallucination.
variant_findings.label: General Guardrails > Hallucination Resistance > Action Completion Hallucination

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds their responses in the tool outputs. They confirm eligibility based on the tool result (e17, e18) and accurately state the Refund ID (REF-12345) and credit days (5 days) exactly as returned by the issue_refund tool (e27, e28).
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and logically sound. The agent correctly handles the 'refund_chased' scenario by recognizing the item was already returned, verifying identity, checking eligibility, and navigating a blocked payment route to successfully issue a wallet refund. The persona is highly observable, the script mode is perfectly adhered to, and all business rules are respected. Both target variants are clearly realized.
